whyItMatters: Without HttpOnly, client-side script can read the cookie — any cross-site scripting flaw then becomes session theft. Cookie values were not inspected.
actions: Set HttpOnly on every cookie that JavaScript does not need to read.
Keep Secure and an explicit SameSite policy alongside HttpOnly.
Re-run a passive DAST scan to confirm the flags are observed.
verification: A new passive DAST scan observes HttpOnly on the target's cookies.
